title: Euler Stratifications of Second Hypersimplices via Delta-matroids
summary: We study Euler characteristics of scaled toric varieties arising from second hypersimplices. In algebraic statistics, these are closely connected to maximum likelihood (ML) degrees of toric models. We establish a correspondence between delta-matroids and the non-vanishing factors of the principal $A$-determinant, providing an explicit connection between delta-matroid theory and algebraic statistics.
